name: Apply Promo Code at Checkout
description: Customers should be able to apply valid promo codes during checkout to receive discounts.
business_rules: Each promo code has a maximum usage limit
Promo codes can be single-use or multi-use
Expired promo codes cannot be applied
Promo code discounts are applied before tax calculation

acceptance_criteria.criteria: User can apply a valid promo code and receive discount
User cannot apply an invalid promo code
User cannot apply an expired promo code
User cannot apply promo code that has reached usage limit
User cannot apply empty promo code
Single-use promo code cannot be reused
Multi-use promo code can be applied multiple times within limit
Minimum order amount requirement is enforced
Promo code with category restriction can only be applied to eligible items
acceptance_criteria.expected_message: Promo code not applicable to selected items

acceptance_criteria.criteria: Maximum discount cap is enforced if defined
